Content: Tay-Sachs disease is a rare inherited disorder caused by an autosomal recessive allele of the `text(HEXA)` gene. Affected individuals exhibit severe neurological symptoms and do not survive to reproductive age. Individuals who inherit one copy of the allele (Tay-Sachs carriers) typically show no symptoms of the disorder.
